item.description:
• Freeze your screen into a picture and wreck it with nine weapons
  • Pistol, minigun, bazooka, flamethrower, laser, freeze ray, Tesla coil, black hole, and sword
  • Mix weapons to shatter ice, make steam, and chain lightning through fire
  • Count down 3, 2, 1, then chase combos, ranks, and trophies
  • Repair everything in one sweep, or save a picture of the wreckage
  • Sound, screen shake, and debris you can tune
  • Nothing real gets touched, and nothing leaves your Mac
